MA	<p>437c_5a75</p> <p>The &alpha;-helix is a right-handed coil in which each backbone N&ndash;H group forms a hydrogen bond with the C=O group of an amino acid located a few residues away. The regular pattern of hydrogen bonding stabilizes the helix, preventing it from unraveling.</p> <p>In a long &alpha;-helix, amino acid <b>number 10</b> would form a hydrogen bond with which two other amino acids?</p><p>Select two correct answers.</p>	amino acid 5	Incorrect	amino acid 6	Correct	amino acid 8	Incorrect	amino acid 9	Incorrect	amino acid 11	Incorrect	amino acid 14	Correct	amino acid 15	Incorrect	amino acid 17	Incorrect	amino acid 18	Incorrect
